note: Cartography content. The continent grids and map rects are imported from Preforged's generated 2022 client tables: src/runtime/gw_map_catalog_generated.h, gw_exploration_rects_generated.h and gw_world_map_dimensions_generated.h (client SHA256 a6fb3c51a52ec5528156b690dc63b4ba51c4b95690d15877d5b49fc3c7dc57ac). A map's rect is in terrain cells (96 game units per cell); a continent's grid is in 32-cell exploration blocks. The optional bounds are the map's own world rect [min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y], read from its Map Parameters chunk where the archive on this machine still holds the map; a map without bounds keeps its grid and gets no position-based reveal. The modern client's wire is 0x008B / 0x008A / 0x008C, not the 2022 numbering.
